results.reason: This study focuses on mother-infant interactions and developmental psychology, which falls outside the scope of clinical psychology practice. While it examines synchrony between mothers and infants, it does not address assessment, diagnosis, therapy, or clinical interventions relevant to practicing clinicians. The study population is infants (7.4 months old) and their mothers, which explicitly falls under the exclusion criteria for papers focused on children/adolescents/infants unless they have direct adult clinical implications, which this study does not.
